note: What a typed client puts on the wire for the kind it is bound to (REQ-DATA-053). Written by hand from docs/reference/store-api.md, 'Address encoding': the kebab-case segment of the kind, the tenant the caller passed ('' where the kind has none), the id the caller passed. The boundary is no part of it: the client reaches the store of its boundary through its socket, and the service takes the boundary from its own bootstrap file (REQ-DATA-013). One kind for each class and scope, plain or hashed because the clients do not seal yet, and one whose name is more than one word.
